exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Planning a Charity Sale
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Lucy: Mr Green asked us to plan a charity event for the school. Any ideas?
Tom: How about holding a charity sale? We could sell things we make ourselves.
Lucy: That's a great idea. What could we sell?
Tom: I enjoy baking, so I could make some cakes and cookies.
Lucy: Perfect. I'm good at painting, so I'll sell some handmade cards.
Tom: Who should we give the money to?
Lucy: Let's donate it to the children's hospital in our city.
Tom: Wonderful. I'm really looking forward to organising it together.
exercises.translation_cn: Green 老师让 Lucy 和 Tom 为学校策划慈善活动;Tom 提议办义卖,卖自己做的东西;Tom 会烤蛋糕饼干,Lucy 擅长画画会卖手工卡片;他们决定把钱捐给本市儿童医院;Tom 很期待一起筹办。

questions.stem: What event are the two students planning?

options: He is too busy for it.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 What a Food Bank Does
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: A food bank is a place that collects food and gives it to people in need.
Volunteers sort the food carefully and pack it into boxes.
Families who do not have enough to eat can come and receive a box for free.
Most of the food is donated by shops, schools and ordinary people.
Thanks to food banks, fewer people in the city go hungry.
exercises.translation_cn: 食物银行收集食物并分发给有需要的人;志愿者仔细分类并装箱;吃不饱的家庭可以免费领取一箱;食物大多由商店、学校和普通人捐赠;有了食物银行,城里挨饿的人减少了。

questions.stem: What does a food bank do?
options: It sells food at low prices.
It grows vegetables on a farm.
It collects food and gives it to people in need.

questions.stem: What do the volunteers do with the food?
options: They sort it and pack it into boxes.
They throw most of it away.

questions.stem: How much do needy families pay for a box?
Where does most of the food come from?
options: Donations from shops, schools and people.

questions.stem: What is the result of having food banks?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 Volunteering at the Animal Shelter
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Mia: I spent my whole weekend volunteering at the animal shelter.
Jack: Really? What did you do there?
Mia: I fed the dogs and helped clean their cages.
Jack: That sounds like hard work. Did you enjoy it?
Mia: Yes, I loved it. The animals are so grateful for a little care.
Jack: Maybe I could join you next time. I'm interested in helping too.
Mia: That would be great. They always need more volunteers.
Jack: Then count me in. I can't wait to meet the dogs.
exercises.translation_cn: Mia 整个周末在动物收容所做志愿者;喂狗、帮忙清理笼子;虽然辛苦但她很喜欢,动物对一点点照顾都心怀感激;Jack 也有兴趣帮忙,想下次加入;Mia 说收容所总缺志愿者;Jack 决定参加,迫不及待想见小狗。

questions.stem: Where did Mia volunteer at the weekend?
What did Mia do there?
options: She fed the dogs and cleaned their cages.

questions.stem: How did Mia feel about the work?
options: She loved it despite the hard work.

questions.stem: What does Jack want to do?
options: Join Mia and help next time.

questions.stem: What does the shelter always need?

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 The Ice Bucket Challenge
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: A few years ago, a fun activity called the Ice Bucket Challenge spread around the world.
People poured a bucket of ice and water over their heads.
Then they asked their friends to do the same or to give money.
The aim was to raise awareness of a serious disease and to collect donations.
In the end, the challenge raised millions of dollars for research.
exercises.translation_cn: 几年前,一项叫'冰桶挑战'的有趣活动传遍世界;人们把一桶冰水浇在头上;然后请朋友照做或捐钱;目的是提高对一种严重疾病的关注并募集善款;最终为研究筹得数百万美元。

questions.stem: What did people do in the Ice Bucket Challenge?
options: They poured ice water over their heads.

questions.stem: What did they ask their friends to do?
options: Do the same or donate money.

questions.stem: What was the aim of the challenge?
options: To raise awareness and collect donations.

questions.stem: How much did the challenge raise in the end?
What was the money used for?

exercises.title: U3 听力·对话 The Used-Book Drive
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Ella: Have you heard about the used-book drive next week?
Sam: No, what is it about?
Ella: We collect books we don't need and give them to a village school.
Sam: What a kind idea! I have lots of old storybooks at home.
Ella: Perfect. Could you bring them to the school library on Monday?
Sam: Of course. Is there anything else I can do to help?
Ella: We also need volunteers to pack the books. Would you mind helping?
Sam: Not at all. I'd be happy to spend Saturday packing books.
exercises.translation_cn: Ella 提到下周的旧书募集活动;收集不需要的书捐给乡村学校;Sam 家里有很多旧故事书,愿意周一带到学校图书馆;他还想多帮忙;Ella 说需要志愿者装箱;Sam 乐意周六去帮忙装书。

questions.stem: What is the book drive for?
options: Giving used books to a village school.

questions.stem: What does Sam have at home?
When should Sam bring the books?
What extra help does Ella need?
How does Sam respond to helping on Saturday?
options: He says he is too busy.

exercises.title: U3 听力·短文 Pass the Kindness On
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a simple way to make the world a little kinder.
The next time someone helps you, do not just say thank you.
Instead, try to pass that kindness on to another person.
You could help a classmate, comfort a friend or give up your seat.
These small acts cost nothing, but together they can change a whole community.
exercises.translation_cn: 让世界更友善的简单方法:下次有人帮你时,别只说谢谢;试着把这份善意传递给别人;可以帮助同学、安慰朋友或让座;这些小事毫不费钱,但合在一起就能改变整个社区。

questions.stem: What is this passage mainly about?

options: Pass the kindness on to another person.
